scope: Review-controller budget handling and human-feedback workflow policy.
guidance: Treat explicit user feedback as an indexed policy contract. Apply budget renewal narrowly to distinct user feedback, preserve audit evidence and all non-budget review limits, and do not claim reviewer-improvement evidence for user-confirmed policy learning.

evidence: F20 exact comment is preserved and classified as a new requirement/preference; no historic reviewer failure or measured improvement is claimed.

core.test.mjs:248-300 source-covers elapsed, cost, combined exhaustion, duplicate/whitespace-equivalent feedback, ordinary resume, and preserved round limit.

dispositions.action: Implemented renewal for distinct trimmed clarification feedback after elapsed-time or cost exhaustion, recording the previous epoch while retaining cumulative usage and review evidence; documented the exception and added scoped regression coverage.
dispositions.lesson: Distinct new user feedback may renew only an exhausted elapsed-time or cost budget epoch. Preserve original start, cumulative cost, archived epochs, evidence, repair count, and the two-round limit; whitespace-equivalent duplicate feedback and ordinary continuation must not renew budgets.

limitations: Independently verified interpretation of explicit human policy; no measured reviewer improvement or recurrence reduction claimed.
